en.about.title: About this project
en.about.concept: This site reproduces the idea behind Google Research's 'The Future of Practice: Enabling Teachers to Create Learning Interactives with Generative UI'. Teachers describe a learning objective and a generative-UI engine assembles an interactive simulation or practice activity with progressive levels, tiered hints, tailored feedback, and worked solutions. Here the generation is driven by a transparent spec/template engine so it runs fully in the browser with no backend or API key.
en.about.link.label: Read the original Google Research article
en.about.library.label: Browse Google's public interactive library
en.about.note: Note: the specific reference interactive 's4ae3f3e' requires a Google sign-in and could not be mirrored directly; the examples here reproduce the same pattern.
en.about.tech: Built with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — no build step, no dependencies. Hosted as a static site on GitHub Pages.
en.footer.text: An open educational experiment · bilingual EN / 中文

zh.about.title: 关于本项目
zh.about.concept: 本站点复现了 Google Research 文章《The Future of Practice：用生成式 UI 让教师创建学习互动》的核心理念。教师描述学习目标，生成式 UI 引擎据此组装出带有分级关卡、分级提示、针对性反馈与解题过程的互动模拟或练习。这里采用透明的“设定/模板”引擎驱动生成，因此完全在浏览器中运行，无需后端或 API 密钥。
zh.about.link.label: 阅读 Google Research 原文
zh.about.library.label: 浏览 Google 公开互动资源库
zh.about.note: 说明：具体的参考互动 “s4ae3f3e” 需要 Google 登录，无法直接镜像；此处示例复现了相同的模式。
zh.about.tech: 使用原生 HTML/CSS/JS 构建——无需构建步骤，无依赖。作为静态站点托管于 GitHub Pages。
